name: maturin-action
description: GitHub Action to install and run a custom maturin command

token.description: Used to pull maturin distributions using GitHub API. Since there's a default, this is typically not supplied by the user.

command.description: maturin command to run. Defaults to "build".

maturin-version.description: Version of maturin to install like "v0.12.0".

manylinux.description: Control the manylinux platform tag on linux.

container.description: Docker container image name. Default depends on "target" and "manylinux" options.

docker-options.description: Additional Docker run options, for passing environment variables and etc.

host-home-mount.description: Host folder where the runner's home folder is mounted to. Used for building using Docker-in-Docker runners

working-directory.description: Working directory to run maturin in.

before-script-linux.description: Script to run before maturin command on Linux.
